kebab_example: aliyun ens describe-load-balancers --ens-region-id cn-guangzhou-10 --server-id i-5f67ffjc004wwz0t0000 --load-balancer-status InActive --load-balancer-id lb-5q73cv04zeyh43lh74lp40000 --load-balancer-name example --network-id n-5s9ayrxsd9hszrlt5fgv20000 --vswitch-id vsw-5sy773iy25rulsmgskmba0000 --address 10.0.XX.XX --ens-region-ids cn-chengdu-telecom-4 --page-number 1 --page-size 100 --load-balancer-type example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeLoadBalancers

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the backend server
parameters.name: server_id

parameters.help_en:
The listener status of the load balancing instance. Valid values:
Active: The listeners of the instance can forward received traffic based on rules.
InActive: The listeners of the instance no longer forward received traffic
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例监听状态。取值：
Active：实例中的监听可以根据规则转发接收的流量。
InActive：实例中的监听不会再转发接收的流量
parameters.name: load_balancer_status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the load balancing instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the load balancing instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_name

parameters.help_en: The service address of the load balancing instance
parameters.help_zh: 负载均衡实例的服务地址
parameters.name: address

parameters.help_en: The list of ENS node IDs
parameters.name: ens_region_ids

parameters.help_en: The page number of the list. Default value: 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paged query. Default value: 10. Valid values: 10 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。默认值：10，取值：10~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The type of the load balancing instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_type
